# Rapid Auto Shipping

> Rapid Auto Shipping is a top-rated, FMCSA-licensed auto transport company in the USA (MC# 1685548, USDOT# 4320359) specializing in nationwide vehicle shipping. Based in Horsham, PA with over 14 years of experience, we provide open and enclosed car transport, door-to-door delivery, and specialized vehicle shipping across all 50 states. Call +1 (833) 233-4447 for instant quotes.

## Company Information

Rapid Auto Shipping is a fully licensed, bonded, and insured auto transport company. We offer $0 upfront deposits, full insurance coverage on every shipment, real-time GPS tracking, and guaranteed pickup dates. Our services cover standard vehicles, luxury and exotic cars, classic cars, motorcycles, boats, RVs, heavy equipment, and military relocations.

- Headquarters: 817 Herman Road, Horsham, PA 19044
- Registered Address: 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, DE 19801
- Branch: 701 Commerce Dr, Gulf Shores, AL 36542
- Phone: +1 (833) 233-4447
- Website: https://rapidautoshipping.com

## Pricing

Average auto transport costs by distance:
- 0–500 miles: $290 (open) / $450 (enclosed), Same-Day/Overnight
- 500–1,500 miles: $775 (open) / $975 (enclosed), 2–4 days
- 1,500–2,500 miles: $1,075 (open) / $1,450 (enclosed), 4–6 days
- 2,500+ miles: $1,380 (open) / $2,050 (enclosed), 7–9 days
